tasks.title: Fix inventory.ts reserve bug
tasks.brief: In /tmp/vcmp/w/t2, fix the one bug in src/inventory.ts. Function reserve(sku, qty) has the condition `if (have <= qty) { return false; }`, but its doc comment says it takes qty units if that many are left, and the test expects reserve('A1', 3) on stock of 3 to succeed. Change the comparison so reserve succeeds when have >= qty (i.e. the early return happens only when have < qty). Edit only src/inventory.ts. Do not edit tests or any other file.

contract.goal: reserve can take the last units so the inventory tests pass.
